ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, ultimate beneficial owners, authorized signatories and counterparties against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, UK OFSI Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, Bermuda's applicable sanctions regulations, and Interpol notices. Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) is mandatory for Politically Exposed Persons, their family members and close associates, requiring senior management approval, source-of-wealth and source-of-funds verification, and ongoing transaction monitoring. Adverse-media and negative-news screening is required as part of standard CDD.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Bermuda Registrar of Companies — official e-Registry / online name reservation portal of the Government of Bermuda (www.gov.bm)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: English is the official legal language. Proposed exempted company names must be submitted in Latin script using standard English alphabetic characters. No transliteration is required. The name must end with 'Limited' or the accepted abbreviation 'Ltd.' and must not be misleading, deceptive, or substantially identical to an existing registered name or reserved name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The initial name reservation is valid for 30 calendar days. A written extension request may be submitted to the Registrar of Companies before expiry, and one further extension of up to 30 calendar days may be granted at the Registrar's discretion. Upon rejection, the applicant (acting through a Bermuda-licensed registered agent) may file a written administrative appeal with the Registrar of Companies within 21 days of the rejection notice, setting out the grounds of appeal, an explanatory memorandum, and, where applicable, prior ministerial or regulatory consent letters. The Registrar will issue a final determination within 14 business days of the appeal. If the appeal is denied, the applicant may propose alternative names for fresh clearance or seek judicial review before the Supreme Court of Bermuda.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted as a substitute. The Companies Act 1981 requires every exempted company to maintain a physical registered office in Bermuda at an address approved by the Registrar and operated through a Bermuda-licensed corporate services provider. A virtual office or mail-forwarding address may only serve as an ancillary communications address and cannot satisfy the statutory registered-office obligation.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate for a standard-risk, non-licensed e-commerce exempted company (estimated 15% annual probability of unannounced physical inspection by the Registrar, BMA, or Financial Intelligence Agency). The likelihood increases materially (to above 30%) where UBO or PEP flags, economic substance deficiencies, sanctions matches, or adverse-media findings arise.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Act 1981 of Bermuda (the 'Act'), principally ss. 4A, 4(3), 7, 15, 16, 79 and 96; read with the E-Commerce Act 2014 and the Fee Schedule issued under the Act.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Companies, Companies Division, Department of Registry General, Government of Bermuda, Hamilton, Bermuda.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Registration as an Exempted Company (Form EC-1) tendered with the Memorandum of Association, Bye-laws and Declaration of Compliance, culminating in a Certificate of Incorporation under s.7 of the Companies Act 1981.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up or escrow-deposit capital requirement. The exempted company may validly incorporate with one issued share of US$1.00 issued at par; authorised capital above BMD 12,000 increases the State incorporation fee and annual fee, not the paid-up requirement.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: THE FIRST WRITTEN RESOLUTION OF THE SOLE DIRECTOR OF [COMPANY NAME] LTD. RESOLVED THAT: (1) the subscribers' share subscription at par of US$1.00 per share is approved and one ordinary share is allotted to [SUBSCRIBER]; (2) the registered office be fixed at [ADDRESS], Hamilton, Bermuda, with [RESIDENT REPRESENTATIVE] as resident representative; (3) [DIRECTOR] be appointed first director and CEO, and [SECRETARY] be appointed company secretary; (4) the director be authorised to open bank and e-money accounts, execute e-commerce platform agreements, and instruct legal counsel; and (5) the incorporation and tax-compliance filings be ratified, including the annual economic substance declaration. This resolution is effective immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Department of Registry General, Hamilton, Bermuda
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File a Name Reservation application (Form NR) listing up to three proposed names in descending preference, accompanied by subscriber identification and the BMD 80 fee. The Registry searches the Companies Register, the reserved-name index, and the undesirable-names list, then issues a Name Clearance Certificate valid for 30 days. Attach the consent of the intended Bermuda resident representative to the subsequent incorporation application.
required_dossiers: Form NR – Name Reservation Application
Three proposed names ranked by preference
Passport copy of each proposed subscriber
Written consent of the intended resident representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Upon refusal for similarity or undesirability, request written reasons, cure by resubmitting Form NR-R with alternate names or supplementary consent letters, and seek administrative re-review within 14 days of refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarization of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Bermuda corporate-service provider or Bermudian notary public; final review by the Registrar of Companies
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum of Association and Bye-laws invoking the Name Clearance Certificate and an objects clause authorising 'retail sale via internet marketplace and ancillary logistics services' (ISIC 4791). Each subscriber executes the documents before a notary public in the presence of a witness, and the subscribers complete the Declaration of Compliance attesting statutory compliance. Notarised originals are retained for lodgment.
required_dossiers: Name Clearance Certificate
Memorandum of Association (executed and notarized)
Bye-laws (executed and notarized)
Form DC – Declaration of Compliance
Subscriber identification evidence
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry queries the objects clause or subscriber formalities, lodge a supplemental corrigendum with fresh notarial execution; utilise the Registry's fast-track amendment procedure to re-file within five business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Exempted Company Incorporation Application
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Department of Registry General, Hamilton, Bermuda
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge Form EC-1 with the notarized Memorandum and Bye-laws, the Declaration of Compliance, particulars and consents of the first director, the registered-office address and resident-representative consent, and the BMD 1,780 State fee. Filing is accepted at the Registry General counter or electronically through an approved service provider using the Companies e-Registry portal; the applicant must verify that the authorised share capital stated on the schedule matches the fee tendered.
required_dossiers: Form EC-1 – Application for Registration as an Exempted Company
Notarized Memorandum of Association and Bye-laws
Form DC – Declaration of Compliance
Consent and particulars of the first director
Form RC – Consent of resident representative
Payment of incorporation fee (BMD 1,780)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: A deficient-filing query attracts a statutory cure period of 21 days; submit a written explanation with amended schedules and, if the proposed activities are found contrary to public interest, withdraw and refile with a revised objects clause.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Opening of Statutory Registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies; thereafter the company's directors at the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation under s.7 Companies Act 1981, which is conclusive evidence of formation. On receipt, the directors open the statutory registers at the registered office — register of members, register of directors and officers, register of charges and minute book — within 14 days, and file the prescribed notice of registered office and officers. The company acquires legal personality from the certificate date and is bound to file its first compliance/annual return within the Registry's prescribed cycle.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Statutory notice of registered office (Form RO)
Statutory notice of directors and officers
Opening of register of members, directors, charges and minutes
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Clerical errors in the certificate are cured by a s.7(3) application for formal correction; late or incorrect officer notices are remedied by an amended filing accompanied by an explanatory affidavit to avoid penalty.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Resolutions and Commencement of Governance Record
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors; corporate records maintained at the Bermuda registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting or pass unanimous written resolutions to adopt the pro forma First Board Resolution — approving the share subscription, fixing the registered office and resident representative, appointing the first director, CEO and secretary, and authorising the opening of banking and EMI accounts with payment rails (Amazon Pay, Stripe, Airwallex). Bind the resolutions into the minute book, issue the share certificate to the subscriber, and calendar the annual economic-substance declaration and FATCA/CRS notification in the compliance workflow.
required_dossiers: Signed First Board Resolution (minutes or written resolution)
Register of members entry and share certificate
Registered-office service agreement
Corporate bank/EMI account mandate and KYC pack
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a banking partner rejects the officer mandate, pass a supplemental written resolution substituting the officer or adding a second director, file the amended officer notice, and resubmit the mandate within five business days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — no Bermudian industrial-licensing board is engaged for ISIC 4791 marketplace retail; the Ministry of Economy and Labour (Department of Business Development) administers digital-trade registration under the E-Commerce Act 2014.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No operating or manufacturing permit is required; the Certificate of Incorporation suffices as the general trading charter, supplemented by any 'regulated business' registration under the E-Commerce Act 2014 and Amazon's online-sales authorisation for FBA fulfillment.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Bermuda Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR), Environment and Natural Resources Division
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt / No EIA Trigger — the enterprise conducts purely virtual internet retail with no construction, manufacturing, waste treatment or land-use change in Bermuda; no screening obligation arises under the Environmental Impact Assessment Regulations 2016. Re-classification to an EIA Registration would occur only upon establishment of local warehousing or distribution centres.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No local discharge, process emission or toxic-waste stream is attributable to the head-office-only model; applicable compliance is limited to safe e-waste disposal under Bermuda's Hazardous Waste Regulations 2015, while goods sold into the UK/EU remain subject to WEEE and packaging-waste extended-producer-responsibility regimes in the jurisdictions of Amazon fulfilment.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not required for a virtual operation without physical premises, employees in Bermuda or hazardous substances. If a future administrative office is leased, prior clearance shall include a Certificate of Occupancy from the Department of Planning, fire-safety certification under the Bermuda Fire & Rescue Service Life Safety Code, and occupational-health registration pursuant to the Occupational Health and Safety Act 1997.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Bermuda: Office of the Tax Commissioner, Tax Revenue Department, Ministry of Finance, Government of Bermuda (portal: https://taxrevenue.gov.bm). UK VAT: HM Revenue and Customs (HMRC), VAT Registration Service (portal: https://www.gov.uk/vat-registration).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: 1) File incorporation documents with the Bermuda Registrar of Companies under the Companies Act 1981; 2) Receive the Certificate of Incorporation and Bermuda Company Number, which is the de facto entity tax identifier because Bermuda does not issue a separate income tax TIN; 3) Appoint a licensed Bermuda registered agent and office; 4) If the company becomes an employer, register with the Tax Revenue Department for payroll tax and obtain a Payroll Tax Account Number; 5) If the company falls within the Bermuda Corporate Income Tax Act 2023 scope, complete the CIT registration through the Tax Revenue Department portal using the Company Number; 6) No Bermuda VAT ID is obtainable because Bermuda has no VAT; 7) For UK Amazon FBA stocks, register with HMRC as a non-established taxable person for UK VAT before any taxable supply is made, providing the Bermuda company number and UK warehouse details.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Bermuda has no domestic check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election for a small exempted company. The company may apply under the Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966 for a certificate guaranteeing exemption from future Bermuda income taxes, commonly issued until 2035. A large multinational constituent entity subject to the Corporate Income Tax Act 2023 may elect resident status or join a tax consolidation group for CIT filing. Foreign owners may make classification elections (e.g., US Form 8832) only in their home jurisdiction; such elections do not alter Bermuda exempt status.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: UK VAT (Value Added Tax); Bermuda has no VAT/GST/Sales and Use Tax
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Bermuda: BMD 0 - no VAT/GST threshold exists. UK: a non-established Bermuda seller must register for VAT before making any taxable supply from a UK FBA warehouse; there is no monetary threshold for non-UK-established businesses. For a UK-established business the annual taxable turnover threshold is GBP 90,000.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: UK does not currently mandate real-time fiscal e-invoicing or digital stamping; Making Tax Digital (MTD) for VAT requires digital record-keeping and API-based quarterly VAT returns for all VAT-registered businesses. Export declarations must be submitted electronically through HMRC's Customs Declaration Service (CDS). Bermuda Customs uses ASYCUDA World for electronic declarations but does not impose an e-invoicing clearance mandate.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: UK VAT zero-rating applies to goods exported from the UK to a destination outside the UK, including sales made by the Bermuda exempted company through Amazon FBA stock, provided: (i) goods are supplied to an overseas customer, (ii) the goods physically leave the UK within 3 months of supply, and (iii) the exporter holds acceptable HMRC export evidence under Notice 703. Sales delivered to UK consumers from UK stock are standard-rated at 20%. Bermuda has no export tax or VAT refund regime. The retained export evidence file also supports any VAT repayment claim from HMRC where input VAT on export costs exceeds output VAT.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (electronic via UK CDS or combined transport document)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill / courier shipping proof
Commercial Invoice (HS code, value, seller and buyer details)
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank remittance evidence of overseas payment
Amazon FBA warehouse removal and export scan records
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: HMRC may retrospectively claw back zero-rated VAT where export evidence is not obtained within the statutory period, assessing VAT at 20% plus default interest. Inaccurate returns attract penalties up to 100% of the VAT amount under Schedule 24 Finance Act 2007, and fraudulent evasion carries imprisonment up to 7 years and an unlimited fine under VATA 1994. Bermuda has no VAT clawback, but false declarations to the Tax Commissioner or Bermuda Customs can result in deregistration, administrative penalties, and criminal prosecution.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Bermuda Monetary Authority (BMA) as the principal financial services regulator; with UK Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) for certain cross-border payment and e-money matters and HM Treasury sanctions oversight for Bermuda as a UK Overseas Territory.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Bermuda Dollar (BMD) is pegged 1:1 to the US Dollar (USD) and is freely convertible for both current account (trade in goods and services, royalties, e-commerce sales proceeds) and capital account (equity contributions, loans, dividends) transactions in an offshore exempted company context. Bermuda does not impose exchange controls on non-resident-owned exempted entities. Profit remittance and dividend distribution are permitted without prior BMA approval, provided the company meets liquidity and solvency tests under the Companies Act 1981 and files required statutory documents. There are no regulatory barriers to converting e-commerce sales proceeds from USD, GBP, EUR or other major currencies into BMD or USD; the practical hurdle is banking partner compliance, not exchange control.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory export proceeds surrender requirement, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no time limit for repatriating trade receipts into Bermuda. An Amazon FBA exporter may retain foreign currency balances in offshore or local bank accounts. The company must nonetheless maintain full books and records to evidence the source of funds for anti-money laundering (AML) and economic substance reporting to the BMA, especially if the entity claims tax residence or seeks a tax residency certificate.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium for foreign fintech electronic money institutions (EMIs) such as Airwallex, Stripe Treasury, or MultiPass, but only as supplemental payment gateways, not as the primary licensed custody bank. Legal constraints: (i) an overseas EMI does not hold a Bermuda deposit-taking licence and therefore cannot offer regulated deposit accounts; (ii) BMA-regulated banks must route all client funds through a licensed bank; (iii) EMI accounts are treated as e-money or payment instrument accounts, not as banking accounts, which may disqualify the entity from obtaining a BMA tax certificate or meeting the economic substance bank account requirement; (iv) the EMI must perform its own KYC/AML and may impose additional transfer restrictions. A Bermuda Exempted Company should maintain a Tier 1 domestic bank account as the master account and use EMIs for collection and disbursement liquidity routing only.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote opening is generally permitted for a Bermuda Exempted Company when supported by a licensed Bermuda registered corporate service provider (CSP) acting as introducer. Directors do not need to be physically present in Bermuda unless a specific bank's policy requires an in-person interview due to the company's risk profile or inadequate documentation. For the standard Amazon FBA general retail scope, all directors and ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) must complete a video/telephone interview with the bank's compliance team; a notarized identification pack and certified passport/utility bill copies are mandatory. If any director is resident in the UK, the bank may require a UK notary or a local HSBC/Butterfield branch visit under a know-your-customer referral arrangement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-face-to-face e-commerce business model with Amazon as the sole sales platform, raising concerns about the provenance of large transaction volumes.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Amazon seller central account verification letter; a notarized copy of the Amazon FBA store registration; six months of Amazon payout reports; marketplace VAT returns; a detailed business model narrative; supplier contracts and logistics invoices; and a signed undertaking confirming no third-party payment splitting.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Bermuda Exempted Company with nominee shareholders or complex ownership, making the UBO chain opaque to the bank.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full corporate registry search from the Bermuda Registrar of Companies; each shareholder's certificate of incumbency; a UBO declaration form identifying all natural persons owning 25% or more; a structure chart; and a signed indemnity from the registered agent validating the ownership chain.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk jurisdiction exposure where supplier or customer banks are located in listed or sanctioned countries.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A geographical compliance matrix showing all counterparty jurisdictions; positive sanctions screening results; a letter from the BMA-approved economic substance provider confirming export activity to be carried out from Bermuda; and a cross-border transaction flow with stated purpose codes (e.g., 'goods purchase', 'platform commission').

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Insufficient evidence that the exempted company has real economic substance beyond tax optimization.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bermuda economic substance declaration; employment records or outsourcing agreements for Bermuda-based management; board meeting minutes held in Bermuda; local office lease agreement; and a projected activity schedule demonstrating the company's export and treasury decisions will be managed from Bermuda.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: PEP (politically exposed person) or heightened media risk associated with any director, UBO, or sanctioned-linked transaction.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Adverse media investigation report; independent PEP screening results; source-of-wealth and source-of-funds declaration with supporting bank statements; professional reference letter from a lawyer or accountant; and if resolved, a detailed mitigation plan acceptable to the BMA AML guidance.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Shareholder capital injections into the Bermuda Exempted Company must be routed through the company's banking account using a purpose of payment that clearly identifies the remitter and the transaction as 'equity contribution' or 'share subscription' under Companies Act 1981. Recommended clearing method: SWIFT MT103 with field 70 (Remittance Information) stating 'CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION – SHARE ISSUANCE' and field 56A (Intermediary Bank) only if required. A Certificate of Good Standing from the Bermuda Registrar, a board resolution approving the capital increase, and the shareholders' register must be available for the receiving bank. For direct inbound payments from Amazon payouts in USD, the settlement uses the local USD clearing system in Bermuda through the BMA's payment infrastructure; all cross-border transfers through a correspondent bank in New York are subject to US OFAC and UK sanctions screening.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Supplier payments and operating expenses are executed primarily via SWIFT MT103 (single payment) or MT101 (bulk instruction from an aggregating treasury account). For commercial letters of credit issued for large purchase orders, the Bermuda bank will issue a documentary LC under ICC UCP 600, and the beneficiary supplier may confirm the LC through a UK or Hong Kong bank. Amazon FBA-related disbursements to logistics providers, fulfillment centers, and customs brokers should be made via the EMI payment rails to reduce FX cost, with final settlement through the master bank account. All outbound remittances must carry a purpose code: 'trade payment for goods', 'logistics and freight', 'platform selling fees', or 'royalty/service fee' as applicable. Payment processing time is typically 1-2 business days for USD/GBP and 2-3 days for minor currencies.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain-vanilla deliverable FX forwards between BMD/USD and any major tradable currency (GBP, EUR, CAD, AUD) executed with a licensed Bermuda or UK bank, provided the underlying trade exposure is documented and the forward maturity matches an Amazon payout cycle.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) in offshore currencies (e.g., CNY/CNH) where physical settlement is not locally required; permissible on a bilateral, non-exchange-traded basis for managing the currency risk of Chinese FBA supplier costs, subject to the bank's internal credit limits and BMA derivative product supervision.

Cross-currency swaps between USD and EUR/GBP for long-term logistics or warehouse lease obligations; the swap must be executed under an ISDA 2002 Master Agreement with a qualifying swap dealer, and the Bermuda Exempted Company must be able to demonstrate a genuine commercial hedging need to avoid speculative classification.
FX options (call/spread) on GBP/EUR/UAH for import cost protection, permissible as over-the-counter transactions with a licensed counterparty; no Bermuda exchange-traded derivatives market exists.

Natural hedging instruments including dual-currency accounts and multi-currency e-wallets within fintech EMI platforms (e.g., Airwallex multi-currency account) used to offset receivable and payable currencies without entering a derivative contract.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies, Bermuda Ministry of Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 January each year; covers corporate particulars as at 31 December of the preceding calendar year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers a default fine of up to USD 500 per instance, plus continued daily default penalties; if the Annual Return remains unfiled for two consecutive statutory periods, the Registrar may publish a strike-off notice and administratively dissolve the company. Restoration requires court order and settlement of all outstanding fees and penalties.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Accountant General of Bermuda / Registrar of Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on or before 31 January of each year, computed on the exempted company's authorized share capital.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment attracts interest at 10% per annum from the due date; continued non-payment for up to two years allows the Registrar to strike the company off the register. Directors may also be subject to personal penalty for failure to ensure payment.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies, Bermuda Economic Substance Agency portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after the end of each financial year; for a calendar-year company, by 30 June (or 31 July under transitional practice) annually.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file the ESD results in initial fines of up to USD 2,000 and escalating penalties under the Bermuda Economic Substance Act 2018, up to USD 400,000 plus officer liability. Repeated default may trigger an assessment, enforcement measures, and administrative strike-off action.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory independent audit for a standard Bermuda Exempted Company carrying on ordinary non-licensed trading activity. Compulsory audit applies only if the company is listed on a recognised stock exchange, is a regulated entity licensed by the Bermuda Monetary Authority, or if shareholders representing at least 5% of voting rights validly require an audit. Otherwise, audit can be dispensed with by unanimous shareholder resolution under the Companies Act 1981.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Bermuda has no prescribed statutory accounting framework for exempted companies; financial statements may be prepared under IFRS or US GAAP. Statutory records must show a true and fair view and are not required to be filed publicly.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Bermuda maintains no public UBO register. The resident registered agent must annually reconcile the Register of Members and record all share transfers occurring in the year, with instruments of transfer properly executed and lodged. The Annual Return confirms members and shareholdings, but no separate UBO declaration is filed publicly. Beneficial ownership information must be maintained internally and produced to the Registrar or Bermuda authorities upon lawful request.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,000 - USD 10,000 per engagement, only if audit is not waived

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% standard Bermuda Exempted Company income tax rate; 15% CIT under the Corporate Income Tax Act 2023 (CITA) for in-scope multinational enterprise (MNE) groups with consolidated revenue of at least EUR 750 million, effective for fiscal years commencing on or after 1 January 2025
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No corporate income tax, capital gains tax, sales tax, VAT, or withholding tax for out-of-scope exempted companies; no statutory tax holidays required. In-scope MNE groups may apply the OECD Pillar Two Substance-Based Income Exclusion (SBIE) carve-out for payroll and tangible assets and may be subject to Bermuda's Qualified Domestic Minimum Top-up Tax (QDMTT). Payroll tax (up to 14.5% on employer payroll) and customs duties may apply to operational activities.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form CIT-1 Bermuda Corporate Income Tax Return, filed electronically via the Bermuda Tax Administration (BTA) e-Filing Portal (Tax Administration and Registration System)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 15 months after the end of the fiscal year (18 months for the first fiscal year); CIT registration within 3 months of entering the in-scope threshold; final CIT payment due on or before the statutory filing deadline

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Entity identification: registered name, Bermuda Entity Number (BEN), registered office, registered agent, date of incorporation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the exact BEN and agent details; non-resident beneficial owners need not be disclosed on the public register; the registered agent must be a licensed Bermuda corporate service provider

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: MNE group determination: name and jurisdiction of the Ultimate Parent Entity (UPE), consolidated group revenue, CITA scope declaration
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the UPE group's consolidated revenue is below EUR 750 million, mark 'Out of Scope' and complete the short-form declaration; attach a supporting group structure diagram if requested

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Financial data: net income (profit or loss before tax), GloBE income adjustments, covered taxes, and jurisdictional effective tax rate computation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use Bermuda GAAP or IFRS figures; reconcile Amazon FBA sales, platform fees, inventory costs, and FBA fulfilment charges; no deduction is allowed for exempted company dividends

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Substance-Based Income Exclusion (SBIE): eligible payroll costs and tangible asset carrying values for Pillar Two carve-out
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident-owned exempted companies generally claim no SBIE; only Bermuda-resident employees and local tangible assets qualify

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax computation: taxable income, net operating loss deductions, CIT at 15%, QDMTT top-up, and total tax payable
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Out-of-scope entities complete '0.00' and certify nil liability; in-scope entities must apply CITA computational rules identical to the OECD GloBE Model Rules

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signatory: name and capacity of the officer in Bermuda certifying the return
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be signed by the Bermuda-resident officer or an authorized fiduciary signatory; foreign directors may not sign unless physically present in Bermuda

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: BMD 10,000 plus BMD 100 per day of continuing default, capped at BMD 250,000; false or misleading return: fine up to BMD 250,000 and/or imprisonment up to 5 years; interest accrues on unpaid CIT; repeated default may trigger a compliance order, asset freeze, and strike-off of the company

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Bermuda Economic Substance Information Return (ESR Return), filed via the Ministry of Finance / Registrar of Companies ESR Online Filing Portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 6 months after the end of each financial year; notification of relevant entity status due within 60 days of incorporation or commencement of relevant activity

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Entity details, financial year end, and selection of relevant activity (select 'Distribution and Service Centre' for Amazon FBA retail resale and related-party services)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A pure passive holding company not engaged in trading should select 'Holding Business' instead; incorrect selection creates a presumption of economic substance failure

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Core income generating activities (CIGA): where purchasing, inventory management, pricing, marketing, and sales decisions are performed
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident owners must disclose any outsourcing to Amazon FBA logistics and third-party agents; the return must list the number of full-time employees in Bermuda and their functions

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Substance details: physical premises in Bermuda, local operating expenditure, board meeting dates, and management and control location
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Document the annual Bermuda board meeting held physically in Bermuda; provide rental agreement, utility records, and payroll filings as supporting evidence

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: BMD 10,000 penalty for failure to file on time; BMD 50,000 penalty for failure to satisfy the economic substance test; daily continuing penalties up to BMD 250 per day; company may be struck off and dissolved; directors and officers may be prosecuted with fines up to BMD 250,000 and/or imprisonment up to 5 years

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Certificate of Compliance and Annual Company Fee, filed via the Bermuda Registrar of Companies e-Registry
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on or before 31 January each year for the preceding calendar year; annual government fee calculated by reference to authorized share capital

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company particulars: name, BEN, incorporation date, share capital structure
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm the company is an exempted company; do not list beneficial owners unless legally required

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office and resident agent certification
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The licensed resident agent must co-sign; a non-resident entity cannot self-certify

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Compliance declaration: issued shares, charges, and confirmation of no winding-up proceedings
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Cease trading on strike-off; verify Amazon seller account details remain valid

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Escalating administrative late fees and interest; default beyond 90 days results in automatic strike-off and dissolution, with company assets (including Amazon settlement balances) vesting in the Crown; restoration requires a court application with substantial costs

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Bermuda imposes no withholding tax on dividends, distributions, or liquidation proceeds paid by an exempted company to any shareholder, resident or non-resident
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable — Bermuda has no comprehensive double taxation agreement with the UK or any other major economy; only Tax Information Exchange Agreements (TIEAs) are in force, so no Treaty Resident Certificate (TRC) can be issued. To evidence tax-exempt status for banking, payment processors, or UK HMRC purposes, obtain a Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Exemption from the Registrar of Companies and, where requested, a certificate of non-taxability from the Bermuda Minister of Finance. A UK corporate parent should apply the UK dividend exemption under CTA 2009 Part 9A for qualifying distributions; the exemption may be denied where the arrangement is tainted by tax avoidance, and UK CFC rules in CTA 2010 Part 9A may attribute undistributed Bermuda profits to the UK parent
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory withholding tax on cross-border royalties and interest under Bermuda domestic law; no treaty rates applicable due to the absence of DTAs; for in-scope CITA groups, intra-group royalty payments remain within the GloBE rules and may trigger recapture or surtax adjustments

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: BMD 750,000,000 (group consolidated revenue threshold aligned with OECD Pillar Two and CITA); Bermuda's transfer pricing framework and mandatory Master File / Local File documentation apply only to in-scope MNE groups; out-of-scope exempted companies have no statutory TP filing requirement, but contemporaneous pricing evidence for intra-group Amazon marketplace and fulfilment arrangements should be retained for ESR and UK CFC defence purposes
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Fully applicable under the Economic Substance (Companies and Limited Partnerships) Act 2018 and ESR Rules 2019. A Bermuda exempted company operating an Amazon FBA general retail business is characterized as a 'Distribution and Service Centre' where it purchases from related parties or provides services to related parties. The company must demonstrate: (i) management and control exercised in Bermuda through physical board meetings; (ii) adequate qualified full-time employees in Bermuda; (iii) adequate operating expenditure in Bermuda; (iv) available physical premises; and (v) local retention of core income-generating contracts and risk-bearing functions. A purely passive holding company is subject to a reduced substance standard. Annual ESR notification and return filing are mandatory.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and False Statements under the Corporate Income Tax Act 2023
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly understating Amazon FBA global sales or mischaracterizing consolidated group revenue to remain below the EUR 750 million CIT threshold; fabricating SBIE payroll and tangible asset data; filing false GloBE Information Returns or ESR Returns; using nominee shareholder chains to fragment an MNE group and avoid in-scope status
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: On conviction, a fine of up to BMD 250,000 and/or imprisonment for up to 5 years; civil penalty of up to 100% of the underpaid CIT; statutory interest on unpaid amounts; public tax compliance orders and asset freezing orders may be imposed
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Courts may pierce the corporate veil: directors, officers, and the Bermuda tax compliance officer are jointly and severally liable for unpaid tax and penalties where they knowingly participated; travel bans and asset freezes may be imposed during criminal investigation; directors face disqualification from holding Bermuda corporate offices

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Economic Substance Regime Non-Compliance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Passing 'Distribution and Service Centre' substance assessments with no local board, no Bermudian employees, no physical premises, and all decision-making conducted outside Bermuda; outsourcing the ESR return without any underlying operational presence; repeatedly failing to notify or file the ESR return for the Amazon FBA business
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: BMD 50,000 penalty for failure to satisfy the economic substance test; BMD 10,000 for late or defective filing; daily continuing penalties; automatic exchange of information with UK HMRC under the UK-Bermuda TIEA; strike-off and dissolution with company assets (including Amazon payout balances) forfeited to the Crown
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the corporate service provider may be personally fined and disqualified; the relevant authorities may require civil restitution of benefits obtained through the substance failure; directors trading after strike-off are personally liable for all debts arising

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Control Failures (AML/CFT)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the marketplace income stream as a payment collection business, holding customer deposits, or settling third-party sellers without registering as a Financial Institution Business (FIB) under the Proceeds of Crime Amendment Act 2015 and without appointing a compliance officer and Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO); failing to conduct sanctions screening on counterparties
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to BMD 100,000 and imprisonment up to 7 years for carrying on an unregistered regulated financial activity; additional monetary penalties by the Bermuda AML supervisory authority; freezing of bank and EMI accounts; confiscation orders under the Proceeds of Crime Act 1997
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the appointed MLRO are personally liable for AML failures; director disqualification, travel bans, and asset confiscation may apply; the corporate veil is pierced where the director directed or consented to the unregistered activity

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: UK CFC Attribution and Fake Offshore Control
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: UK resident directors routinely making all Amazon FBA decisions from London, executing bank mandates in the UK, and claiming Bermuda residence only to avoid UK corporation tax; failing to disclose the management and control shift to HMRC; holding the Bermuda exempted company as a UK tax resident in substance while enjoying Bermuda's 0% regime
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: HMRC CFC assessment on the attributable profits of the UK parent at the UK corporation tax rate; penalties for deliberate error of up to 100% of the tax undercharged, enhanced to 200% in aggravated cases; statutory interest from the original filing date
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Senior Accounting Officer (SAO) personal penalties of up to £5,000 per accounting period for failure to maintain reasonable tax accounting arrangements; criminal penalties for tax evasion include imprisonment up to 7 years; courts may issue freezing orders against directors' personal assets if the corporate veil is pierced

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to file the Annual Certificate of Compliance or pay the Bermuda government annual fee by 31 January; continuing to trade or operate the Amazon seller account after a strike-off order; making false statements in the Certificate of Compliance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Automatic strike-off and dissolution after the statutory default period, with all company assets (including Amazon settlement proceeds and bank balances) vesting in the Crown; restoration requires a court order with substantial costs, penalties, and HMRC tax clearance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who act or trade after the company is struck off are personally liable for all contracts and debts incurred; directors' authority over the Amazon merchant account is terminated; restitution orders may require directors to reimburse the Crown for vested assets
